purpose: Illustrative conditional operating characteristics; not asset success probabilities or a powered protocol
sd_interpretation: Paired designs: between-person SD of a baseline-adjusted active-minus-control benefit contrast. Parallel: within-arm SD of baseline-adjusted outcome. Same numerical SD is not an empirically matched comparison.
worthwhile_difference_basis: Analyst scenario only; not a validated PC-specific threshold, MCID, or regulatory criterion
missingness: Independent missing-completely-at-random loss. Family sensitivity loses entire two-person families. Does not model outcome-dependent dropout, unsafe exposures, nonadherence, or failed recruitment.
effect_distribution: Normal analysis-unit contrasts; no patient-level NRS observations are simulated or fitted. Bounded ordinal outcomes, skewness and heterogeneity require later sensitivity analysis.
source_of_effect_sd_and_icc: Explicit assumptions, not estimates from the two-patient Lee report or between-patient natural-history SD
no_interpretable_result: Fewer than three independent analysis units, or fewer than three observed people in either parallel arm
